title: I’m so glad I’m not the only one
content: This sub popped up as something that might be of interest and boy was the algorithm correct! Buildings figure prominently in my dreams and the mall is one of the biggest. Often in in an immense department store with ceilings way too high, looking for the perfect makeup and none of the counters have what I want. Or I’m looking for a dress and get distracted by designs I’d never in my life wear. The mall is labyrinthine, often with amusement rides or a train that does a full circuit inside. Sometimes the floor is uneven and getting one place to the next is an uphill climb. It’s not always a mall either. Sometimes an open bazaar like I visited in Pakistan; here I’m usually looking for jewelry or occult supplies. Sometimes a huge hotel where I’m trying to find a room to get to know a gentleman friend better. A favorite is a cityscape where I’m discovering new shops or restaurants, elaborate churches, or places like giant office buildings that have an observatory on the top floor. I’m actually excited to discuss this more. I really thought I was the only one who created these subconscious spaces.
